negative_evidence: The SORN is a computational neural-network account fitted qualitatively to human sequence-learning effects; it is not a direct measurement of STDP/IP/synaptic normalization in participants.
The task-specific motor output/readout is supervised and externally defined; the recurrent network should not be mislabeled as an endogenous inverse motor model.
Interference and facilitation emerge from inherited SORN plasticity architecture; they are not evidence that this paper independently invented the SORN family.
unresolved_issues: Computational account does not directly establish participant-level synaptic implementation.
Inherited SORN family ancestry remains explicit.

annotation: direct model ancestor 10.3389/neuro.10.023.2009; global genealogy independence not certified

preserved_noninferences: motor target/body/environment cannot automatically become internal skill or coordinator state
training schedule cannot automatically become learning operator
fitted latent variable cannot automatically become stored memory
learned parameter cannot automatically become an additional active controller
offline/training plasticity cannot automatically become online coordinator
complexity or fit failure cannot imply A2
no genealogy path/citation is not independence
